on:

    paths-ignore:

name: CI

env:
  RUST_TOOLCHAIN: stable
  TOOLCHAIN_PROFILE: minimal

jobs:
  fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: stable / fmt
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check
  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: stable / clippy
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - name: cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --workspace -- -D warnings
  doc:
    # run docs generation on nightly rather than stable. This enables features like
    # https://doc.rust-lang.org/beta/unstable-book/language-features/doc-cfg.html which allows an
    # API be documented as only available in some specific platforms.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: nightly / doc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install nightly
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - name: Install cargo-docs-rs
        uses: dtolnay/install@cargo-docs-rs
      - name: cargo docs-rs
        run: cargo docs-rs -p vaultrs
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: stable / test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-targets --all-features --workspace -- --include-ignored
      # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: cargo test --doc
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --workspace --doc

  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: [fmt, clippy, test]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
            profile: ${{ env.TOOLCHAIN_PROFILE }}
            toolchain: ${{ env.RUST_TOOLCHAIN }}
            override: true
      - uses: katyo/publish-crates@v1
        with:
            registry-token: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
